name: libreagent-agent-builder
description: Install LibreAgent step by step, then create private or organization agents with native H24 computer setup and durable backup status.

interface.shortDescription: Install LibreAgent, create agents and choose H24 hosting.
interface.longDescription: Install LibreAgent with a guided, interactive onboarding (join your team, add a computer, or start for the first time on Mac, Windows or Linux), create an agent from a chat request, choose personal or organization access and an owned remote computer for H24, connect ChatGPT by code in Codex, and review private backup status.
